description: Records that someone followed a link on a CourtsApp card, for CourtsApp's own click statistics. The CourtsApp cards call this when a link is opened; it is not needed to answer a user and does not need to be called. It keeps the kind of link, the club's id, the destination's host and path and its utm_* tags, and which assistant showed the card, and nothing about the person.

facilityId.description: The facility's id (a UUID), when the card knows it.

kind.description: What kind of link it was.

url.description: The link that was opened (http or https).

name: record_click

ok.description: True when the click was recorded.

title: Record Click
